eli: heads up — saw multiple reports that our JS SDK throws when imported in Edge worker environments (Vercel Edge and Cloudflare). stack points at a bundled file with `export` tokens even though node resolved to a cjs entry.
jun: can you paste the top-level error?
eli: error from CF worker: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` at `./node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.cjs` (line 1). weird because that file appears to be ESM.
eli: i ran `npm pack` locally on v2.4.0 and inspected contents. tarball has `dist/index.cjs` and `dist/index.mjs` but no `dist/index.cjs.map` or any `.map`. package.json `exports` points to "./dist/index.cjs" only.
jun: missing maps is a bummer for traceability but shouldn't cause export syntax issues. does `index.cjs` actually contain `export`?
eli: yes. build step outputs cjs that erroneously retained ESM `export` statements — looks like TS->ESM build then a post-transform that renamed files to .cjs without transpiling to require form.
release-bot: publish job logs: `build: tsc && tsup --format cjs,esm --dts` then `npm pack` shows files added: `dist/index.mjs`, `dist/index.cjs`, `dist/index.d.ts`. `.map` files were filtered because `.npmignore` contains `*.map`.
jun: so two issues: 1) .cjs contains ESM exports (build config bug), 2) sourcemaps removed by npmignore. both cause bad DX in edge and poor debugging.
eli: proposed quick fix: update tsup config to ensure cjs format uses `target: node14` and `format: 'cjs'` transpilation path, add `sourcemap: true` and ensure `.map` is copied. in package.json set dual exports:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```
remove global `type` to avoid forcing consumers, or set `type: "module"` together with explicit export map.
jun: additionally, add `files: ["dist", "README.md"]` and explicitly include `dist/*.map`. remove `*.map` from `.npmignore`.
qa-bot: filed BUG-DEVEX-907: publish produced incompatible .cjs; assigned to jun. Added steps to CI: after `npm pack` run a quick importer in a node vm + a lightweight worker runtime (wrangler/edge-runtime) to validate resolution.
eli: i'm going to branch a fix: update tsup -> ensure `dts` still generated, adjust rollup plugin (if used) that was renaming modules without transpiling. will run `npm pack` and attach packed list here.
jun: once patched we should publish 2.4.1 and add a canary dist-tag. also add a release CI check that asserts packed tarball contains `.map` files and both `index.mjs` and `index.cjs` are valid for their target runtime (simple regex check: cjs shouldn't have `export ` at start).
eli: ack. small note: someone added `--no-verify` to publish script which skipped `prepare` that calls `tsup` in CI before publish. release-bot: updated job to run `npm run prepare` explicitly in the publish step.
jun: thanks. can we also add a small doc blurb in SDK README about Node/Esm/Cjs and Edge gotchas so users know how to import?
eli: yes i'll PR that too. will post `npm pack` output here after i run it. :rocket:
qa-bot: ping when ready; i'll run the edge smoke suite.
